basic_details.short_information: PM SHRI School Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (PM SHRI JNV Bhadrak) Teachers (PGT/TGT) Notification 2026 has been released on the official website of PM SHRI School Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (PM SHRI JNV Bhadrak). A total of 3 vacancies have been announced through the PM SHRI JNV Bhadrak Teachers (PGT/TGT) Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 50 years for all posts. Age relaxation will be applicable as per the government rules.

qualification.education_qualification: Master in Computer Application/M.Sc. or M.E. or M.Tech.(Computer Science/IT), Bachelor in Computer Application/B.Sc. or B.E. or B.Tech.(Computer Science/IT), Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized institution / Bachelors/honors degree with B.Ed.
qualification.details: PGT Computer Science: Master in Computer Application/M.Sc. or M.E. or M.Tech.(Computer Science/IT) from recognized university/institute with at least 50% marks & above. TGT Computer Science: Bachelor in Computer Application/B.Sc. or B.E. or B.Tech.(Computer Science/IT) from recognized university/institute with at least 50% marks & above. TGT English: Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks in the concerned subjects as well as in the aggregate including B.Ed. component. OR Bachelors/honors degree from a recognized institution with at least 50% marks in concerned subject, combination of subjects as well as in the aggregate and B.Ed. degree from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks/three years integrated B.Ed./M.Ed. from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks.

salary_details.details: PGT Computer Science: Rs.35750/- Per Month TGT Computer Science: Rs.34125/- Per Month TGT English: Rs.34125/- Per Month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for PM SHRI JNV Bhadrak Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PM SHRI JNV Bhadrak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 03 August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Teachers (PGT/TGT) posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for Teachers (PGT/TGT) posts announced by PM SHRI JNV Bhadrak for the year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for PGT Computer Science?
faq.answer: For PGT Computer Science, candidates must have a Master's degree in Computer Application/M.Sc. or M.E. or M.Tech. (Computer Science/IT) with at least 50% marks from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the PGT/TGT posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the PGT/TGT posts is 50 years as of 01 January 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through email. Candidates need to send their application and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for TGT posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for TGT Computer Science and TGT English posts is Rs. 34125/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Virtual Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all detailed information regarding the recruitment.
